summary: Strive, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board maintained the 13.00% per-annum dividend rate on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (SATA) and declared daily cash dividends of $0.0516 per share (about $1.0836 per month, 21 business days) for October 1-31, 2026, payable to holders of record on the preceding business day. The filing also notes distributions may be treated as return-of-capital for tax purposes, reflecting no accumulated or projected earnings and profits. No special-situation transaction, no advisor, and no deal terms are involved.
